DM7 Series OSC Specifications — Version 1.1.0 (Yamaha, Jul. 1 2025)
===================================================================
Text extracted from DM7_osc_specs_V110_en.pdf for grep-ability.
The PDF is authoritative; this is a convenience artifact.

Extraction notes:
  - The PDF is AES-128 encrypted with an empty user password (owner
    restrictions only). Streams were decrypted and text pulled with
    per-font ToUnicode CMaps.
  - Layout is reconstructed from glyph coordinates. Rows are correct;
    multi-column tables interleave their columns on a shared line, and
    "  |  " marks a horizontal gap. Verify any table row against the PDF
    before relying on it.

1.4.1.OSC address format pattern........................................................................3
1.4.2.Parameter setting examples........................................................................4
OSC (Open Sound Control) is a protocol for transmitting control information of electronic musical
instruments / audio equipment, etc. via a network. This protocol can be used to remotely control the
DM7 series. This document describes the connection and setup procedure for remote control using
this protocol and lists the necessary parameter information.
2.Parameter...............................................................................................9
2.1.Parameter List...........................................................................................................9
2.2.Parameter Value Detail...........................................................................................17
DM7 Series OSC Specifications Version 1.1.0  |  2

1.Setup
1.1.Connection Procedure  |  1.3.Configuring the Remote Controller
Connect the remote controller to the network terminal of each device as shown below. The   |  DM7 series can be controlled from an external device via Ethernet (NETWORK terminal).
device to be controlled is specified by its IP address. Connect DM7 Series to the Network PC   |  The settings on the remote controller side for each connection are as follows -
terminal (computer connection terminal for external control) via the Network port on the rear   |  IP Address: Specify the IP address of For Mixer Control of the DM7 Series to be controlled.
panel. Up to four OSC remote controllers can be connected to one DM7 Series console.  |  IP Port No.: UDP 49900
1.4.Configuration Examples
DM7 Series
Up to 4 Ethernet
Remote   |  Below are several example commands set using an OSC Controller, in this case with the QLab
Controllers  |  application. QLab does not require type tags to be added to the command. A type tag may be
required depending on the OSC Controller application, please check this for the OSC controller
DM7 Editor  |  to be used.
EthernetNetwork Ethernet
Switch
EthernetNetwork Port
1.4.1.OSC address format pattern
OSC address format pattern for parameters:
/yosc:req/<Action>/<Parameter ID>/<X>/<Y> <value>
FormatCommand Notes
/yosc:req/yosc:req"yosc:req" is a Yamaha identifier
Action/set
Parameter ID/MIXER:Current/parameter1/parameter2/parameter3
X index/X  |  i.e channel number
Y index/Y  |  Y index is not always required, it depends
on the paramaterID. It can be omitted
when not needed.
argument valuevalue (integer or string)value must always be seperated from
address or other value by a space
1.2.DM7 Series Configuration
IP address setting:  |  OSC address format pattern for direct scene recall:
Uses the same IP address as Editor and StageMix.  |  /yosc:req/<Action> <type tag> <Parameter ID> <value>
Open the NETWORK window from SETUP in the menubar, and select “For Mixer Control”.
FormatCommand Notes
/yosc:req/yosc:req"yosc:req" is a Yamaha identifier
Action/ssrecallt_ex
Parameter IDscene_a or scene_bscene list A or B. Must be a space between address and value
argument valuescene numberIf using Qlab or Companion, scene number must be "x.xx", if
using Toush OSC omit "".
①①①
②②
②
OSC address format for scene recall inc/dec:
/yosc:req/event <Parameter ID>
Format CommandNotes
/yosc:req/yosc:req"yosc:req" is a Yamaha identifier
Action /event
Parameter IDMIXER:Lib/Scene/RecallInc scene_ascene list A or B
MIXER:Lib/Scene/RecallDec scene_a
MIXER:Lib/Scene/RecallInc scene_b
MIXER:Lib/Scene/RecallDec scene_b
1) Select “Static IP”.
2) Specify the IP address and subnet mask.
